name: inherited-board-fill-in
query: I've got a half-finished backlog someone handed me - the epics are written but every story is still the blank template. Can you fill them in?
why: The core inherited mode: existing items, unfilled skeletons, real IDs to preserve.

name: greenfield-from-goal
query: Our goal is to get the ingestion platform stable in production within 60 days. What should the epics, features and stories be?
why: Greenfield mode: a stated goal and horizon with no backlog yet.

name: greenfield-from-repo
query: Read through this repo and build me a sprint backlog for adding multi-tenant support
why: Greenfield with a grounding source, which is the common shape - the repo defines current state.

name: split-a-story
query: STORY-NNNN01 is way too big, it's really three separate things. Split it up.
why: Sizing and splitting with a live board ID that must survive the split.

name: sequence-the-backlog
query: Can you work out the right order for these features and figure out what depends on what?
why: Sequencing and dependency recording is a named step of the procedure.

name: audit-existing-board
query: Go through user-stories.md and tell me what's wrong with it - missing acceptance criteria, orphaned items, anything that won't survive review
why: The audit catalogue and pre-handoff checklist are part of this skill.

name: write-acceptance-criteria
query: These stories have no definition of done or testing approach. Write them.
why: Acceptance criteria authoring is a first-class part of the item anatomy.

name: maintain-markdown-backlog
query: I keep my epics and features as markdown in this vault - add a feature for the reporting work and slot it in properly
why: Maintenance mode in a vault or repo where the files are the standing record.

name: casual-decompose-phrasing
query: break this initiative down into workable chunks for the team
why: Decomposition intent without any agile vocabulary; the situation is the trigger, not the words.

name: partial-board-gap-fill
query: This board is about a third built. Fix up what's there so it makes sense, then work out what's missing and add it.
why: Partial mode with the two-phase repair-then-extend order and NNNN placeholders for new items.

name: stories-too-big
query: These stories are all way too big, nothing here would finish in a sprint. Cut them down.
why: The 1-to-2-day sizing ceiling and the splitting seams are core to the skill.

name: not-session-task-tracking
query: add a todo to check the test suite before we commit
why: In-session task state belongs to the task tools, not to a board artifact.

name: not-a-spec
query: Write a technical specification for the new authentication service
why: Specification authoring is spec-driven-development; a backlog is a different artifact.

name: not-project-status
query: How far along is the ingestion work?
why: A status question answered from context, not a request to plan or write a backlog.

name: not-generic-agile-question
query: What's the difference between an epic and a feature in SAFe?
why: A definitional question with no artifact to produce.

name: not-implementation
query: Implement the retry logic in the ingestion job
